prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: scroll-driven website PC assembly frame, stage 1
Input images: Image 1 is the sole edit target and geometry anchor.
Primary request: Create a photorealistic intermediate assembly frame of exactly the same black gaming PC case from Image 1. The chassis stays fully stationary in exactly the same three-quarter camera angle, crop, scale, perspective, silhouette, feet, front panel, power-supply shroud, black studio background, floor reflection, lighting, shadows, yellow case accent and overall color grade. Remove the tempered-glass side panel so the interior is openly visible. Inside the case, install ONLY the motherboard in its correct real mounting position. The motherboard must be a realistic full-size black ATX board aligned naturally to the rear I/O and standoffs, matching the final image's motherboard geometry as closely as possible.
Critical invariants: keep the outer case, camera, framing, canvas aspect ratio, background, lighting and every chassis edge pixel-close to Image 1; change only the internal assembly state and remove the glass.
The installed motherboard must have a clearly empty CPU socket with no CPU, empty RAM slots, and empty PCIe slots.
Remove completely: CPU, CPU block/pump, heatsink/cooler, radiator, all case and radiator fans, RAM modules, graphics card/GPU, liquid-cooling tubes, power/data cables, cable combs, loose wires, side glass and any floating parts.
Constraints: physically believable component scale and mounting; clean open chassis; no text, labels, logos, watermark, extra props, hands, tools, dust or particles. Do not redesign the case. No parts may float or overlap incorrectly.
